report.summary: Test-infrastructure-only change: merges the worker, UI and component vitest configs into one projects config, runs UI and component tests in vmThreads with 2 workers each, and makes workspace-events cases concurrent (maxConcurrency 4) using test-context expect. All 67 cases use context expect. Fixtures are isolated per case (distinct user, project, DO and FakeTempod; all queries scoped by id; no global mocks or timers). The two changed test files pass under the new config (78/78). No source or spec behavior changes. The full suite has 4 failures in untouched areas (custom agents, OP_STEPS) caused by @tempo/protocol resolving to the main checkout at /home/user/tempod, not this worktree; they match the stale-protocol typecheck errors.

findings.text: seedWorkspace reads the shared seedCounter after seedProject's await, so concurrent cases can get the same slug and branch. This is harmless now because the unique indexes workspaces_active_slug and workspaces_active_branch are per project_id and each case seeds its own project. It would break if concurrent cases ever shared a project.

evidence.why: The counter is read after an await while other concurrent cases increment it. Uniqueness is scoped per project, so there is no collision today.

findings.text: With 4 concurrent workspace setups per file, the existing 5000 ms waitFor deadlines (first prompt, turn running, event applied) run under more contention. They passed locally well within budget. A CI timing report from a loaded runner would confirm the margin.

evidence.why: This fixed per-wait budget is shared by four concurrent DO setups. It is not a failure, but it is a potential flake source on a slow runner.

checked.risk: Tests: concurrent cases sharing globals, spies, DOM or expect; assertions that can run zero checks
Build/runtime environment: vitest projects config, vmThreads pool, worker pool settings preserved, tsconfig includes, ran changed tests and full suite
Cache correctness and CI budget: turbo task inputs cover the new config; no scripts reference the removed -c invocations; docs/CI.md updated
Idempotency/state: D1 unique constraints vs concurrent seeding
Real contracts, failure paths, security, spec: no production source, protocol or spec changes in this diff; only test and config files changed
